NewAiResolvedAssignment.description: Resolved profile for an action — both the storage row and its ID.

providerType.description: Provider type for this profile. Use `"external"` to delegate all HTTP transport to  {@link  PlatformAdapter.externalFetch  }  while reusing an existing provider's response parser — see  {@link  Profile.basedOn }  for the format selector.

basedOn.description:
Selects the response-format parser used by the `"external"` provider. Ignored for any other `providerType`.

Supported values are `"openai"`, `"anthropic"`, `"mistral"` and `"openrouter"`. Remaining values (`"genai"`, `"stabilityai"`, …) are accepted by the type but not yet implemented; passing one raises an error at request time.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider API.

key.description: API key or token. Optional for local providers.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request to this provider. Merged into the SDK client's default headers; an explicit `Authorization` here wins over the one derived from  {@link  key  } . Honoured by the OpenAI-family providers.

modelId.description: Selected model ID within this provider.

reasoning.description: Whether extended thinking is enabled for this profile's model.

capabilities.description: Bitmask of capabilities supported by the selected model.

canUseTool.description: Result of the live tool-capability probe performed at create time and on changes to `modelId` / `providerType` / `baseUrl`. `undefined` means the probe has never run for this profile (legacy record).

useResponsesApi.description: Result of the live Responses-API probe (parallel to  {@link  canUseTool  } ). `true` means the model speaks `/v1/responses` and the OpenAI provider must route through `client.responses.create` — required for gpt-5+ reasoning models that reject `reasoning_effort` together with `tools` on `/v1/chat/completions`. Probed at create time and whenever `modelId` / `providerType` / `baseUrl` change. `undefined` means the probe never ran (legacy record) — readers treat that as `false`.

isCloudProvider.description: Whether this profile uses a cloud-hosted provider (e.g. ONLYOFFICE DocSpace).

useProxy.description: Route every provider request through the host's `fetchProxy` instead of the global `fetch`. Useful when the host runs the widget in a sandbox without direct network access (CORS, custom auth, etc.). Has no effect when the  {@link  PlatformAdapter.fetchProxy  }  is not configured.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ms since epoch). Used to sort the AI models list newest-first.

NewAiProfile.description: Complete AI provider + model configuration saved by the user. Profiles are the primary way users save and reuse provider configurations.

NewAiProviderType.description: Provider type identifier. Accepts all 17 built-in types with autocomplete, plus any custom `string` for dynamically registered providers.

NewAiBuiltinProviderType.description:
Union of all 17 built-in AI provider type identifiers.

The `"external"` provider has no built-in transport — it delegates every HTTP request to `PlatformAdapter.externalFetch` and parses the response with the inner provider selected by `Profile.basedOn`.

NewAiAssignmentMutationResult.description: Outcome of  {@link  AssignmentsEngine.assign }  /  {@link  AssignmentsEngine.unassign } . Either a success or a field-scoped error suitable for displaying in the profile editor.

NewAiBulkAssignmentResult.description: Outcome of  {@link  AssignmentsEngine.bulkAssign } . Either every entry persisted, or no entries persisted and a per-key error report. The engine validates first and writes second so a single bad entry never leaves the assignment table in a half-written state.

source.description: Origin of the attachment. `"user"` — uploaded by the user in the composer (the default when unset, for backward compatibility). `"tool"` — produced by a tool call (e.g. `generate_image`). Lets the integrator's adapter route or apply policies (separate bucket, quotas, TTL, CDN) per source.

messageId.description: Owning message id once linked. Unset while the attachment is a draft.

threadId.description: Owning thread id once linked. Unset while the attachment is a draft.

entityId.description: Opaque scope token (entity / "room") the attachment was created in. Drafts carry it so an entity switch keeps in-flight composer state isolated; once linked to a message the field is redundant with the thread's own entity binding.

NewAiAttachment.description: Persistent record for a single attachment (file or image) referenced from a user message. Files carry extracted text in `content`; images carry base64 data in `base64`. Metadata (`title`, `path`, `type`) is always present for display purposes regardless of whether the heavy payload is loaded.

NewAiCreateProfileInput.description: Input for creating a new profile — the same shape as  {@link  Profile }  without the engine-generated fields (`id`, `createdAt`).

NewAiProfileMutationResult.description: Outcome of `create` / `update` — either a success carrying the persisted profile, or a failure with a field-level error description from the name check or the provider credential check.

id.description: Model identifier as used by the provider API (e.g. `"gpt-4o"`, `"claude-sonnet-4-20250514"`).

name.description: Human-readable model name for display in the UI.

reasoning.description: Whether this model supports extended thinking / chain-of-thought reasoning.

capabilities.description: Bitmask of model capabilities (Chat, Image, Vision, Tools, etc.). Used to filter models per  {@link  ActionType  } .

NewAiModel.description: AI model metadata. Describes a single model available from a provider.

NewAiCreatePromptInput.description: Input for creating a prompt — the engine generates `id`/`createdAt`/`updatedAt`.

NewAiPromptMutationResult.description: Outcome of `create` / `update` / `move` on a prompt — either the persisted prompt or a field-scoped error.

name.description: Prompt display name shown in the prompt picker.

text.description: Prompt template text. May contain placeholder tokens.

folderId.description: Optional parent folder ID. `undefined` means the prompt is at the root level.

createdAt.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) when the prompt was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) of the last prompt modification.

NewAiPrompt.description: Saved prompt template that users can quickly insert into the chat.

NewAiFolderMutationResult.description: Outcome of `createFolder` / `renameFolder` — either the persisted folder or a field-scoped error.

createdAt.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) when the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) of the last folder modification.

NewAiPromptBundle.description: Versioned, self-contained bundle of every saved prompt and folder. Stable wire format — `version` lets the import path migrate older shapes if the schema ever changes.

NewAiImportResult.description: Outcome of  {@link  PromptsEngine.importBundle } . Either every entry persisted with counts, or no entries persisted plus a per-entry error report.

kind.description: `"folder"` or `"prompt"`, plus the offending name or id.

title.description: Optional thread title. Auto-generated from the first message if not set.

lastEditDate.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) of the last message in this thread. Used for sorting.

provider.description: Provider configuration at the time of last message. Used for thread-level provider display.

model.description: Model info at the time of last message.

profileId.description: ID of the profile used for this thread. Links to  {@link  Profile.id } .

NewAiThread.description: Chat conversation metadata. Represents a single chat session (thread).

name.description: User-defined display name for this provider connection.

key.description: API key or token. Optional for local providers (Ollama, LM Studio).

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider API.

NewAiTProvider.description: Minimal provider connection configuration. Used to connect to a provider API.

entityId.description: Opaque scope token persisted on a freshly created thread. Ignored when `threadId` is provided (the existing thread keeps its scope).

NewAiOpenOrCreateInput.description: Input for  {@link  ThreadsEngine.openOrCreate } : open an existing thread if `threadId` is given, otherwise create a new one with an auto-generated title derived from `firstMessage`.

id.description: Storage-assigned message id (absent on inbound drafts).

content.description: Message content: either plain text or a list of typed content parts (text, image, tool-call, …). Parts are open-ended by content type.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp, ISO-8601 on the wire.

title.description: Empty string for existing threads — the engine doesn't re-fetch.

NewAiOpenOrCreateResult.description: Resolved thread state returned by  {@link  ThreadsEngine.openOrCreate } .

NewAiMcpServerConfig.description: One MCP server configuration. The shape is intentionally open — MCP allows per-transport fields (`command`/`args` for stdio, `url` for HTTP, plus env, headers, etc.) and the storage layer stays agnostic to which transport is in use.

NewAiToolsMutationResult.description: Outcome of an MCP-server CRUD call. Either success or a field-scoped error suitable for the settings form.

name.description: Tool name as registered on the MCP server (e.g. `"web_search"`, `"insert_text"`).

description.description: Human-readable description shown to the AI model and in the tools list UI.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters.

enabled.description: Whether this tool is currently enabled. Disabled tools are hidden from the AI model.

requireApproval.description: Whether the consumer must show an approval dialog before this tool runs. The engine reads it when deciding the `autoAllow` flag on a `tool-call-pending` event: `requireApproval === false` auto-allows the call (no dialog), `true` always prompts. `undefined` leaves the decision to the persisted "always-allow" list alone — so MCP / custom-server tools (which never set it) keep prompting as before, while host tools opt into auto-allow by default. Wire-serializable, so it survives a remote (server-side) engine.

NewAiTMCPItem.description: Descriptor for a tool exposed by an MCP server.

NewAiToolsBulkResult.description: Outcome of  {@link  ToolsEngine.replaceAllCustomServers }  — either every entry persisted, or no entries persisted plus a per-key error report.

key.description: API key for the provider. Optional for self-hosted or keyless setups.

baseUrl.description: Optional override for the provider's base URL.

isCloudProvider.description: Whether this provider is cloud-hosted (vs. self-hosted).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with each request to the ONLYOFFICE / cloud backend (e.g. `X-Tenant`). Merged after the derived `Authorization` header, so a custom header of the same name wins.

NewAiWebSearchConfig.description: Web-search provider configuration. Credentials and provider selection for the built-in web-search tool group.

NewAiWebSearchMutationResult.description: Outcome of  {@link  WebSearchEngine.configure }  — either the persisted config or a field-scoped error suitable for the settings form.

input.description: A file attachment draft to persist.

items.description: A file attachment draft to persist.

input.description: An image attachment draft to persist.

items.description: An image attachment draft to persist.

folderId.description: Target folder id, or `null` for root.

profile.description: Profile used to regenerate the title.

map.description: Full replacement set, keyed by server name.

value.description: Whether the tool is always allowed.

profileId.description: Profile id bound to the agent.

prompt.description: Agent system prompt; stored as the room's `chatSettings.prompt`.

private.description: Whether the agent room is private.

attachDefaultTools.description: Whether to attach the default DocSpace MCP tool server.

indexing.description: Whether room content is indexed for search.

denyDownload.description: Whether downloading room content is denied.

chatSettings.description: Chat settings (`ChatSettings`); requires a valid provider/model.

sendFormToExternalDB.description: Whether form results are sent to an external DB.

saveFormAsXLSX.description: Whether forms are saved as XLSX.

indexing.description: Whether room content is indexed for search.

denyDownload.description: Whether downloading room content is denied.

deleteAfter.description: Delete the room after the editing session finishes.

items.description: A DocSpace room id: an integer for native rooms, a string for third-party-backed ones.

quota.description: New quota in bytes; a negative value disables the custom quota.

items.description: A DocSpace room id: an integer for native rooms, a string for third-party-backed ones.

roomIds.description: Agent (room) ids to reset to the tenant default quota.
